items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Clark Monroe and all the guys or the boys of the evening used to laugh

ctx.x: He took your advice and said there's a lady in the house.

I says "Lady" and..... Then Oh, he laughed, he just cracked up. And every time since they were together, "Come on, Lady." "Lady?" Clark Monroe and all the guys or the boys of the evening used to laugh, "Yes, she is a lady." They said Lady Day and finally Clark Monroe took it up, you know what I mean, and different peoples from there to Mindon's Playhouse and everybody took it up that's as Lady Day. I read in some magazines where he gave the name but they didn't think about it because I said, I'll let them go…
Do you remember how long she stayed with the band, until what year?
